issues.t: cloudcontrol: a pattern-violating DesiredState value is refused by the downstream handler (InvalidRequestException, async) instead of the front-door schema ValidationException
cloudcontrol: the AWS::SNS::Topic handler not-found message served by GetResource omits the "(SDK Attempt Count: <n>)" segment

cloudcontrol: a stack provisioned through CreateResource(AWS::CloudFormation::Stack) is not observable through CloudFormation's own reads — DescribeStackResource never reports the stack's WaitCondition as CREATE_IN_PROGR
cloudcontrol: a mid-flight CancelResourceRequest never reaches CANCEL_COMPLETE — no request is ever cancellable, so a cancelled create's resource is left in place
cloudcontrol: DesiredState Tags are never written to the owning service, so SSM ListTagsForResource refuses the just-created parameter with InvalidResourceId

cloudcontrol: a Cloud Control CreateResource of AWS::CloudFormation::Stack never becomes observable at CloudFormation, so an in-flight create window can neither be released nor driven to a terminal state (check hangs)

cloudcontrol: 4 net-new causes — CloudFormation-provisioned resources are invisible to GetResource, the stored resource model carries only client-supplied properties (so a JSON Patch replace of a server-defaulted propert
cloudcontrol: no NON_PROVISIONABLE public resource type exists in the registry, so CreateResource/GetResource can never answer UnsupportedActionException (405)
cloudcontrolapi resource identifiers and DeleteResource acceptance diverge from AWS
cloudcontrolapi refusals answer 404 or 200 where AWS answers 400 with the modeled error payload

cloudcontrol: 2 net-new causes — CancelResourceRequest answers NotImplemented instead of AWS's cancel refusal semantics, and AWS::S3::Bucket CreateResource reports SUCCESS without creating the bucket in S3
Implement cloudcontrol ListResourceRequests: unimplemented scaffold stub
Implement cloudcontrol CancelResourceRequest: unimplemented scaffold stub
cloudcontrol: 9 net-new causes — DesiredState/PatchDocument are never validated against the resource type schema and refusals that AWS makes are reported as SUCCESS

cloudcontrol: 6 net-new causes — Cloud Control's private store is not joined to the owning services (Logs, CloudWatch, SQS, SSM), resources created elsewhere are invisible, and Identifier/read-only properties are wrong
cloudcontrol: 10 net-new causes — Cloud Control refusal messages, error codes and error classifications diverge from AWS
